summary: This Form 8-K is filed by The Cooper Companies, Inc. to report its fiscal Q2 2026 earnings results under Item 2.02 and to disclose a $271.6M litigation charge under Item 8.01 related to a voluntary recall of embryo culture media. The filing does not describe any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event. It is a routine current report providing operational results and an update on legal proceedings. Therefore, it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
